svg.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: PostgreSQL 16 · 3NF relational core · time-series partitioning · self-referencing dependency graph · pgvector 384-dim embeddings
Every physical thing in the plant
CHECK asset_type IN (Plant, Line, Pump, Motor)
PARTITION BY RANGE (time), 1 day per partition
CHECK failure_type IN (TWF, HDF, PWF, OSF, RNF)
so it can be undone exactly
Crow's foot = many · single bar = one · dashed line = written by trigger, not by a foreign key · dashed box = scaffolding, not part of the domain model

Normal form: 3NF throughout. assets is the single source of asset identity; the hierarchy is an edge table, not a parent_id column, so one asset can have many dependents and the graph is traversable in both directions.
